payload.text: Utilz's first cut in this shape fires every leg on its candidate's run, and its RELEASE seal names each one; the core's object step attaches Menuz.app.zip before any after: command runs; and `tools/formula publish --pull`, the one after: command, moves homebrew-utilz to the new tag and pulls this machine's clone of it. The formula through the core alone goes to issue I59c806c. Reworded on hv decision 14 (23 Nov 2026).
